title: 2020 All-Star Truck Giveaway Winner Takes Home Freightliner
summary: Landstar Million Mile Safe Driver and Roadstar® Bobby Jordan and his wife Miche are headed home to Soso, Mississippi, with Bobby’s new Freightliner® Cascadia® 126!
body_markdown:
Landstar Million Mile Safe Driver and Roadstar® Bobby Jordan and his wife Miche are headed home to Soso, Mississippi, with Bobby’s new Freightliner® Cascadia® 126!


Watch as the winner of the 2020 Landstar All-Star Truck Giveaway starts the engine of his new ‘Landstar blue’ truck for the first time.
